purpose: Policy-preserving common-controller engineering comparison, not new architecture efficacy confirmation
tapes: Recreate the already opened original R14 tapes from the original seed offsets; no new efficacy sample or checkpoint selection
identity_gate: Every episode record, action, observation, fee, correctness and utility must equal the original reference in every repeat
timing_scope: Full original execute call with cold planner, model copy, model start, inference, control, owner and trace assembly; world preparation separate and common
reporting: All orders and per-call CPU/wall records retained; repeated timings are not independent training fits
limits: No new training, no change to R14 acceptance; CPU timing is not joules, GPU performance or intrinsic HX efficiency; both ordinary and HX receive the same optimization
